notes: The current implementation compares claims and always returns user text unchanged in shadow/enforce states.
No completion claim is supported by read-only evidence or model prose.
Historical mismatch samples do not override later verified evidence.

PR #471: when FEATURE_SINGLE_SPEAKER_APPROVAL_UX is on and a turn's reply is Gateway-owned, run_agent() still calls observe_shadow_finalizer() (app.py:3813 as of ffa678a7) before its early return, passing an empty agent-text string and approval_prompt_sent derived from the Gateway's own owner_notified flag. RP5's evidence classification is therefore exercised on Gateway-owned approval turns too, not only on Agent-authored text turns. This audit updated turn_coordinator_routing to carry rp5 as conditional optional evidence instead of hard-excluding it (task_profiles/profiles.json) precisely because of this reachability; treat any remaining profile that still hard-excludes rp5 from an approval/turn-ownership-scoped task as a scoping simplification to re-check, not proof RP5 is never invoked on that path.
